{{Top|leg}}
'''Butter pastries''' were a food type served on the cruise ship ''[[Bastion Princess]]''<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Bhindi Drayson]] gave her last pastry to [[Trey Courser]] as a reward for swiftly completing the necessary sabotage work on the ship as part of a [[Wraith Squadron]] ruse.<ref name="MK" />
